items.where: whole Wibautstraat front and both end faces: eight light grey concrete spandrel bands (about 1.5 m, proud with a dark shadow line under each) alternating with seven ribbon windows of reflective glass between dark grey mullions about 3.1 m apart
items.how: ribbon(): glass wall on the slab outline, a 0.3 m proud concrete strip per band, dark mullion fins every 3.1 m behind the bands

items.where: ground storey: full-height glazing set back behind square concrete columns about 6.2 m apart under the first band
items.how: ground glass wall 0.6 m behind the slab line, 0.6 m concrete columns at 6.2 m, soffit under the first band

items.where: two red entrance canopies on the ground storey: a long flat one at the south entrance and a rounded one over the hotel door carrying a small Volks HOTEL sign
items.how: thin red slabs on the colonnade line, the north one with a dark sign panel; sign text too small to letter at ride distance

items.where: a tall colourful artwork standing on the hotel-door canopy (a different piece in the 2021 capture and the 2024 capture)

skip.note: the piece changed between the 2021 and 2024 captures, so no one shape is the building

items.where: top storey: a glazed storey set back from the slab under a thick flat roof slab that oversails it, downlights in the soffit (w03 aimed view)
items.how: recessed glass storey 27.6-31 m with dark mullions, 1.2 m white roof slab oversailing 1.8 m with a soffit

items.where: free-standing dark letters on the roof edge at the north end of the front, read ...HOTEL (the left part hidden by the tree)
items.how: VOLKSHOTEL in pixel letters on a dark rail on the roof slab: the name is the building's (nl.wikipedia) and the canopy sign reads Volks HOTEL

items.where: north end face: the same bands and ribbons, four panes across; ground storey glazed behind a column
south end face: bands and ribbons four panes across over a glazed restaurant ground storey
north part of the front: ground storey glazing behind columns, bicycle parking in front
the low rear wing behind the neighbouring houses: white bands and ribbon windows like the slab, 4 storeys
items.how: ribbon() on every wing edge, three bands over a glazed ground storey

items.where: a painted advertising column and terrace tables in the south yard

skip.note: a free-standing painted advertising column on the public yard, not part of the pand, moved and repainted over the years
